name: Comoros

flag.description: Four horizontal stripes of yellow, white, red and blue, with a green triangle at the hoist containing a white crescent and four white five-pointed stars in a vertical line.
flag.symbolism: The four stripes and four stars represent the islands of Mohéli (yellow), Mayotte (white), Anjouan (red) and Grande Comore (blue); the green and crescent represent Islam.

hook: Comoros counts four stripes and four stars for four islands in a green hoist triangle, including Mayotte, which France still governs.
trivia: The flag still claims Mayotte, which voted to remain with France and is now a French department.
The waters off the Comoros are home to coelacanths, a 'living fossil' fish once thought extinct for millions of years.
